steps.en: Start the Prometheus server; its UI and API listen on port 9090
steps.zh: 启动 Prometheus 服务，界面和 API 在 9090 端口

steps.en: Expose a /metrics page from your service with a client library, or run an exporter
steps.zh: 用客户端库让服务暴露 /metrics 页面，或者跑一个 exporter

steps.en: List the targets to scrape and how often in prometheus.yml
steps.zh: 在 prometheus.yml 里列出要抓取的目标和间隔

steps.en: Pulls every target's /metrics over HTTP on each interval and stores the samples locally
steps.zh: 每个间隔通过 HTTP 拉取各目标的 /metrics，样本存进本地时序库

component.zh: 抓取器 + 本地时序库

steps.en: Write PromQL for graphs and alert rules
steps.zh: 用 PromQL 写图表查询和告警规则

steps.en: Evaluates the rules continuously and sends firing alerts to Alertmanager
steps.zh: 持续计算规则，把触发的告警发给 Alertmanager

value.en: Every service's health as queryable numbers, and a page when a rule crosses its threshold — with no external database
value.zh: 所有服务的健康状况都变成可查询的数字，规则越线就告警——不需要外部数据库

sources: https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/main/README.md (docker run --name prometheus -d -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 prom/prometheus; pull model; no dependency on distributed storage)
